task.ques: Search for a yoga mat on Amazon that is at least 6mm thick, non-slip, and eco-friendly. The price should be under $50.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: IUGA Yoga Mat, Ocean — $36.99 on Amazon, under $50 before delivery and tax. The listing states 6mm thickness, “Non Slip,” and “Eco Friendly”; its description identifies TPE material without latex or PVC. Dimensions: 72 × 24 inches.
Source (checked October 27, 2026): https://www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B0786J23XT
Evidence: final.png shows the full product name, all three required features, the selected Ocean color, and the $36.99 new-item price together.
